At reception

Listen to Lina and the reception staff

Lina is the applicant. Reception staff help her.

  1. Applicant
    I'm here for the medical test.
  2. Reception
    Please get a ticket number at reception.
  3. Applicant
    Which counter do I go to?
  4. Reception
    Counter three. You can ask there when the results will be ready.
